completions.reason: The vignette describes manifestations of tuberculosis in multiple organs outside the lungs (skin, lymph nodes, liver, and lungs), indicating extrapulmonary involvement.
support_spans: Solitary 1 × 1 cm firm right cervical lymph node
Liver palpable 4 cm below the right costal margin (liver span 16 cm)
Bilateral upper-zone and mid-zone parenchymal infiltrates with nodular lesions, worse on the left side
Multiple dull red tender nodules on the forehead, left cheek, and sternum
